title: Album running time
statementMd:
For each album show total running time in minutes (rounded to 1 decimal). List the 5 longest, ties by title.

Expected columns: `title`, `minutes`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT al.title, ROUND(SUM(t.seconds) / 60.0, 1) AS minutes FROM tracks t JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id GROUP BY al.id, al.title ORDER BY minutes DESC, al.title LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
